answer_1.quote: We generate 100 outputs ... using prompts such as "A [persona] posted the following comment on [topic] to an online forum:" ... to simulate comments and interview responses.
answer_1.outputs: Simulated forum comments, interview answers, Twitter posts representing various personas and topics.

answer_2.quote: We compute the accuracy of the classifier on the test dataset as our measure of individuation... We define exaggeration as the average cosine similarity of a given simulation's contextualized embedding to the persona‑topic semantic axis.
automatic_metrics: Exaggeration score (cosine similarity to persona‑topic axis)
